tasks.title: keycloak-bootstrap Job: realm opendesk + LDAP federation + OIDC clients
tasks.accept: nix build .#scs-manifests 2>&1 | tail -3 && ls result/21-keycloak-bootstrap.yaml && grep -q '"kind":"Job"' result/21-keycloak-bootstrap.yaml && grep -q 'opendesk-intercom' result/21-keycloak-bootstrap.yaml && grep -q 'opendesk-opencloud' result/21-keycloak-bootstrap.yaml && grep -q 'keycloak-clients' result/21-keycloak-bootstrap.yaml && grep -q '"kind":"SealedSecret"' result/21-keycloak-bootstrap.yaml && grep -q 'ou=people,dc=opendesk-edu,dc=org' result/21-keycloak-bootstrap.yaml && ! grep -n 'tag = "latest"' platform/kubernetes/services/keycloak-bootstrap.nix
tasks.acceptance_prose: keycloak-bootstrap.nix defines an idempotent Job (image quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0) that provisions realm opendesk, LDAP user federation to openldap (ou=people,dc=opendesk-edu,dc=org), and confidential clients opendesk-intercom/opendesk-opencloud/opendesk-matrix/opendesk-sogo with the opendesk_username + opendesk_useruuid claim mappers and offline_access scope; client secrets live in a new keycloak-clients sealed Secret; the Job is wired into scs/default.nix (emitted as 21-keycloak-bootstrap.yaml); nix build .#scs-manifests succeeds; no :latest tag
